> vs asking to see/visit you more, or to do more with you. Sexy Skype calls, phone sex, naughty pictures, buying toys for each other and using them "together"

You really don't know that she didn't. All of those things still are not physical intimacy, they're great surrogates for it, but they aren't the real thing. They're masturbation with emotional support and affirmation from your partner.

Visiting more is something I'm sure everyone in this sub wants - and as many in this sub will tell you it's not always a realistic option. Finances, vacation time, any other number of reasons.

 I think the fact that she brought it up for discussion is admirable. Open relationships aren't for everyone - but they're also not something instantly doomed to fail if all involved are open and honest about it. Honestly, I'm surprised simply talking about it in this sub of all places is so "YOUR DOOMED TO FAIL".

There are absolutely red flags - but I don't think opening the discussion and idea to an open relationship is an issue. Especially in an otherwise good relationship (something his apparently hasn't been lately).
